 Isha Garg Updated on 14 Nov 2026, 07:05 AM IST Switch to 
 The Bar Council of India (BCI) will issue the AIBE 22 admit card on November 14, 2026. Candidates can download the AIBE 22 admit card from the direct link that will be provided below. Registered candidates can also visit the official website, allindiabarexamination.com, to access the AIBE admit card 2026. The AIBE hall ticket includes the candidate's details, roll number, exam centre, and exam-day instructions. The AIBE 22 admit card  is an important document to appear for the exam. BCI will conduct the  AIBE 22 exam on November 29, 2026. 
 Also check:  AIBE PYQs  (Past 10 Years) |  AIBE Mock Test  (FREE) |  AIBE Sample Paper 
 Live | Nov 14, 2026 | 6:50 AM IST AIBE 22 Admit Card 2026 LIVE: BCI XXII hall ticket today at allindiabarexamination.com, exam on November 29 
 The AIBE 22 exam will have 100 questions, each carrying 1 mark, making the total marks 100. There will no negative marking for incorrect answers. Candidates will be awarded 1 mark for each correct response, and the final score will be calculated out of 100.
 AIBE 22 Admit Card 2026
 AIBE 22 Admit Card 2026 - Live Updates
 14 Nov 2026, 07:05 am IST
 AIBE 22 Admit Card to be Released Today!
 BCI will issue the AIBE 22 hall ticket today, November 14, 2026, on the official website. Candidates can download the AIBE 2026 admit card from the direct link that will be provided soon. 
 14 Nov 2026, 06:00 am IST
 Can I appear for AIBE 22 without a hall ticket?
 No, candidates are not allowed to appear for AIBE 22 without the admit card. As per the exam-day guidelines, the AIBE 2026 admit card is a mandatory document to gain entry to the exam hall.
 14 Nov 2026, 04:00 am IST
 What to do after downloading AIBE 2026 admit card?
 Once candidates download their AIBE 2026 admit card, they should take a printout for the exam day. Candidates can carry only one copy inside the exam hall. Also, candidates must ensure that all details mentioned on the hall ticket are correct.
 14 Nov 2026, 02:00 am IST
 Do I need to carry a colour printout of the AIBE admit card 2026?
 It is not mandatory to carry a colour printout of the AIBE 22 admit card. Candidates can either take a black-and-white printout or a colour printout of the admit card. However, it must be ensured that the details mentioned on the admit card are legible and the candidate’s photograph is clear.
 14 Nov 2026, 12:00 am IST
 What to do if my name spelling is wrong in the AIBE 22 admit card?
 Candidates whose names are misspelled in the  AIBE 2026 admit card must report it to the AIBE helpdesk. They will be required to submit their Aadhaar card or state bar enrolment certificate as proof of identity. 
 13 Nov 2026, 10:00 pm IST
 AIBE Admit Card 2026: How to Report Errors?
 Candidates can report any errors in the AIBE 22 admit card directly to the helpdesk. It is advisable to submit the error as soon as possible. The AIBE helpdesk is availble Monday to Sunday from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM. 
 13 Nov 2026, 09:16 pm IST
 How many copies of AIBE admit card 2026 are needed for the exam?
 Candidates are required to carry only one clear copy of the AIBE 22 admit card. It is the most important document for appearing for the exam. Candidates must keep the AIBE 2026 hall ticket safe. 
 13 Nov 2026, 08:30 pm IST
 AIBE 22 Time
 BCI will conduct the AIBE 22 on November 29, 2026, from 1 PM to 4 PM at the designated exam centres. Candidates can check the assigned AIBE 22 exam centre on their respective admit cards. 
 13 Nov 2026, 07:30 pm IST
 Documents Required on AIBE 22 Exam Day
 Candidates are required to carry the AIBE 22 admit card on the exam day. Entry is not permitted into the exam hall without the hall ticket. Other permitted documents to carry on the AIBE 22 exam day are listed below. 
 AIBE 22 admit card
 Passport-size photograph
 A valid ID proof such as Aadhaar card, voter ID card, PAN card, driving licence, passport, or Advocate Enrollment ID issued by your State Bar Council (if applicable)
 Bare Acts (without notes)
 Copy of disability certificate (if applicable)
 13 Nov 2026, 06:45 pm IST
 What if I forgot my AIBE 2026 admit card login password?
 If a candidate has forgotten the login password and is unable to download the AIBE 22 admit card 2026, they can follow the steps given below -
 Visit the candidate login portal
 Click on the "Forgot Password" button on the login screen.
 Next, enter the login ID
 Candidates will receive a password reset link at their registered email address or mobile number.
 Click on the link and create a new password.
 Log in to the AIBE admit card portal 2026 using the new password.

 No, BCI does not issue any physical copy of the AIBE 22 hall ticket. Candidates are required to download the AIBE 22 admit card online from the candidate's login.

 What is the AIBE Admit Card Download Last Date?
 Candidates who have registered for AIBE 22 can download the admit card until the day of the exam. In case candidates lose their printed copy, they must download the AIBE hall ticket again from the candidate login.

 The AIBE 22 admit card is expected to be released late in the evening. The previous session's hall ticket was released around 11:30 PM.

 Candidates can download the AIBE 22 hall ticket from the direct link that will be provided in this article. They can click on the direct AIBE admit card download link and enter their login credentials to access the hall tickets.

 AIBE 22 Admit Card Tomorrow!
 BCI will release the AIBE 22 admit card tomorrow, November 14, 2026, on the official website. Candidates can download the hall ticket through their login portal.

 Steps to Download AIBE 22 Admit Card 2026
 Once the hall ticket link is active on November 14, candidates can download their AIBE 22 hall ticket by following these steps:
 Visit the official AIBE website at allindiabarexamination.com
 Click on the "AIBE 22 Admit Card 2026" link on the homepage
 Enter candidate’s registered user ID and password to log in
 Click on the "Admit Card" tab
 Check all the details carefully, download the PDF, and take a clear printout for exam day
 Details Mentioned on AIBE XXII Hall Ticket
 The AIBE 22 admit card will contain the following details:
 Candidate’s full name, father/husband name and candidate’s photograph
 Enrollment number (advocate registration ID) and AIBE 22 roll number
 Category (general, OBC, SC, ST, PwD)
 Exam language
 Name of the centre, centre code and complete address
 Exam date and reporting time
 Mandatory exam-day instructions

 All candidates must strictly follow these rules at the test centre on November 29, 2026:
 Bring a printed copy of the AIBE XXII admit card and one original government photo ID (Aadhaar card, voter ID, passport, or driving licence). Digital copies on phones are not allowed. Entry will be denied without the admit card in hard copy.
 Arrive at the allotted AIBE 2026 test centre at least 1.5 hours, i.e. at 11:30 AM, before the exam begins.
 Only Bare Acts (without notes and comments) are permitted inside the examination centre. Books, guidebooks, or handwritten notes are strictly banned.
 Electronic gadgets such as mobile phones, smartwatches, calculators, and earphones are strictly prohibited.
 Mark answers on the OMR sheet using only a blue or black ballpoint pen.
 Write the roll number on the answer sheet exactly as printed on the candidate’s admit card and shade the matching ovals properly. Any mismatch will result in disqualification.
 Read and strictly follow all instructions printed on the test booklet cover.
 Candidates cannot leave the examination hall before the exam concludes without handing over their AIBE answer sheet to the invigilator.

 By Industry Law Lawyer
 A lawyer advises clients on legal matters, represents them in court, and drafts legal documents. They work in various fields like criminal, corporate, or family law. Key skills include communication, research, and analytical thinking. To become a lawyer in India, one must complete a law degree, clear entrance exams, register with the Bar Council, and pass the All India Bar Examination.
 4 Jobs Available Civil Lawyer
 A civil lawyer handles non-criminal legal disputes like family, property, and contract issues. They represent clients in court, draft documents, and advise on legal rights. To practice in India, one needs an LLB degree and Bar Council enrollment. Civil lawyers work in firms, government, or independently, with growing demand across various specialisations.
 3 Jobs Available Human Rights Lawyer
 Individuals in the human rights lawyer career path are legal professionals responsible for advocating for people whose inherent dignity has been violated and who have suffered a lot of injustice. They take cases to defend the human rights of minorities, vulnerable populations, the LGBTQI community, indigenous people and others.  
 2 Jobs Available Criminal Lawyer
 A criminal lawyer defends individuals or organisations accused of crimes, ensuring fair trial and legal rights. They analyse cases, represent clients in court, conduct legal research, and negotiate plea deals. Strong communication, analytical, and ethical skills are essential. After earning a law degree, gaining experience, and registering with a Bar Council, they can practise independently or with law firms.
 2 Jobs Available Family Lawyer
 Family lawyers are required to assist a client in resolving any family-related problem. In general, family lawyers operate as mediators between family members when conflicts arise. Individuals who opt for a career as Family Lawyer is charged with drafting prenuptial agreements to protect someone's financial interests prior to marriage, consulting on grounds for impeachment or civil union separation, and drafting separation agreements. 
 2 Jobs Available Cyber Lawyer
 Cyber lawyers look into matters that involve cybercrimes, data breaches, and online privacy concerns. The role requires individuals to draft legal documents, represent clients in court, and help organisations with cybersecurity regulations and compliance.
 2 Jobs Available Immigration Lawyer
 An immigration lawyer is responsible for representing the individuals (clients) involved in the immigration process that includes legal, and illegal citizens and refugees who want to reside in the country, start a business or get employment.  
 2 Jobs Available Government Lawyer
 A Government Lawyer represents the government in legal matters, provides legal advice to officials, drafts legislation, and prosecutes or defends cases. The role requires strong research, communication, and analytical skills. To pursue this career, one must obtain an LLB, pass the Bar Exam, gain court experience, and apply for government positions. Career progression includes roles from junior to senior government lawyer.
